text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, I have no regrets. Because I gave everything I currently have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, how do you feel
about today's results?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Being able to run without regrets was all thanks
to your help, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I will continue to devote myself so I can take 1st place next time,
so I look forward to working with you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
! Always aiming high... That is an important mindset.
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I believe this race has made it clear
which areas I need to improve upon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I would be grateful if we could discuss the training
routine for our next race together.
I look forward to working with you."
